title: Substance
notes:
Posthumous compilation of Joy Division songs, released in July 1988.
It compiles the four singles that did not appear on the albums and also collects tracks from [m=28414], [m=173930], [m=512922] and [m=54032].
The tracks from the appendix are only featured on cassette in some regions and CD issues worldwide.

Peaked at no. 7 of the UK album charts, and at no. 146 of the US Billboard 200, marking the band's only chart appearance in the United States.

The 1992 re-release by London Records features a new longer version than the original 12" mix of "She's Lost Control" (also found on Factory compilation [m=23459] and [m=23154]), while the other editions have the version featured on the "[r=29007]" single. Re-released again in 1999/2000, and remastered in 2015.
